pages.title: Tuff Building Blocks
pages.text: Tuff is a sedimentary rock and supports the same common stone forms as other rock types. Its building set includes smooth stone, bricks, mossy blocks, cracked bricks, chiseled bricks, slabs, stairs, walls, and $(l:mechanics/aqueducts)aqueducts$().

pages.title: Halite in Tuff
pages.text: Halite forms very large, flat deposits in sedimentary rocks, including tuff. Mining a halite block directly yields salt powder, which can be used to preserve food.
